subject: How to write a one-line vision your AI can use
script: Most project visions are useless to an AI. Here's a one-line vision it can actually use. Fill in three blanks: a what, for who, that does what. A budgeting app, for freelancers, that predicts slow months. Not a mission statement. Not ten adjectives. Then test it. If this line changed, would your AI build something different? If yes, it works. Put it in your Flayel Vision bucket, and every tool you use reads it. Try Flayel free at flayel dot com.
